topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I stepped outside to the familiar hush of the morning, the kind that wraps around you like a blanket. The driveway, usually a stage for the daily routine of departures and arrivals, stood unusually bare. The spot where my car should have been was just an empty space, a question mark etched into the pavement. The sun was climbing higher, casting long shadows where my car used to cast its own solid form. I looked around, half expecting to see it hiding behind the mailbox or the bushes, as if it had played a trick and would reappear with a honk and a flash of lights. But the driveway remained an open page, waiting for the next chapter.
